units.source_text: 男人沿着那条路走过去，

en.t: The man walked along that road,

units.source_text: 在“渔业联合组织”前的空场上玩耍的孩子们，

en.t: the children playing in the open space in front of the Fisheries Cooperative,

units.source_text: 坐在歪斜的走廊上织鱼网的老人们，

en.t: the old men sitting on the crooked veranda and mending fishing nets,

units.source_text: 以及聚集在仅有的一间杂货店门口头发稀疏的女人们，

en.t: and the thin-haired women gathered outside the only general store,

units.source_text: 一下子都停住了手和嘴，投来惊讶的目光。

en.t: all at once stopped their hands and their talk, and turned surprised looks toward him.
But the man paid no attention at all,

units.source_text: 让他关心的只有沙子和昆虫。

en.t: for the only things that concerned him were sand and insects.
